name: INTAGE HOLDINGS Inc.
summary: INTAGE HOLDINGS Inc. provides marketing research and data-driven business intelligence solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Marketing Support (Consumer Goods & Services), Marketing Support (Healthcare), and Business Intelligence. The Marketing Support (Consumer Goods & Services) segment supports the marketing activities of companies. The Marketing Support (Healthcare) segment conducts market research for over-the-counter drugs, as well as for prescription drugs.
